title: Etale triple algebras map flatly to the strict henselization completion
statement: Let R be a Noetherian local commutative ring with maximal ideal m, let K be a separable closure of its residue field, and let C=R^{\mathrm{sh}} be the strict henselization defined as the filtered colimit of pointed etale R-algebras with residue embeddings into K [lem-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-triples]. For every algebra S occurring in this filtered triple category, the canonical map S\to\widehat C=\varprojlim_n C/(mC)^n, induced by S\to C, is flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map].
